channel.title: 3ABN Today
channel.desc: Join host Danny Shelton for an inspiring conversation with Restoration House Inc., a Christ-centered reentry ministry equipping returning citizens for a fresh start. Learn how their practical services-safe, comfortable housing, job training and placement, and spiritual guidance-help men and women reintegrate and rebuild their lives with dignity. Be encouraged by stories of transformation and a gospel-driven call to reduce recidivism and restore hope in our communities.
